You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 8a229359570d1c73ec375de98083365f420a0fd7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Melissa Linkert <melissa@glencoesoftware.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2016 13:17:56 -0600
Subject: [PATCH] Flex: fix file indexing when multiple runs are present

Fixes the bug introduced by 7aecd0.
---
 components/formats-gpl/src/loci/formats/in/FlexReader.java | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/components/formats-gpl/src/loci/formats/in/FlexReader.java b/components/formats-gpl/src/loci/formats/in/FlexReader.java
index acb6755427..76b731a3d7 100644
--- a/components/formats-gpl/src/loci/formats/in/FlexReader.java
+++ b/components/formats-gpl/src/loci/formats/in/FlexReader.java
@@ -1369,7 +1369,7 @@ public class FlexReader extends FormatReader {
           FlexFile file = new FlexFile();
           file.row = row;
           file.column = col;
-          file.field = field % runCount;
+          file.field = field % (nFiles / (wellCount * runCount));
           file.file = files.get(field);
           file.acquisition = runDirs.size() == 0 ? 0:
             runDirs.indexOf(new Location(file.file).getParentFile());
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect calculation of the `file.field` index when multiple runs were present. The original code used `field % runCount`, which did not account for the total number of files divided by the product of `wellCount` and `runCount`. This led to incorrect indexing when accessing files, resulting in potential out-of-bounds errors or incorrect file references. The patch corrects this by changing the calculation to `field % (nFiles / (wellCount * runCount))`, ensuring that the indexing properly reflects the total number of files available for the given runs and wells.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect calculation of the `file.field` index when multiple runs were present. The original code used `field % runCount`, which did not account for the total number of files divided by the product of `wellCount` and `runCount`. This led to incorrect indexing when accessing files, resulting in potential out-of-bounds errors or incorrect file references. The patch corrects this by changing the calculation to `field % (nFiles / (wellCount * runCount))`, ensuring that the indexing properly reflects the total number of files available for the given runs and wells.
